query: Find etch sensor traces for failed wafers in chamber C2

assets.grain: one second per row; file is one wafer process run
limitations: All IDs, outcomes and signals are synthetic
Chamber association is not evidence of causality

provenance.purpose: Illustrative manufacturing context generated for the demo

consumer_rules: Resolve relative_uri against repository root; verify SHA-256 before reading
Join only on documented keys and check cardinality
Never mix synthetic and real observations into a training population
Exclude test outcomes, IDs and context-only fields from predictors
Fit all preprocessing on training data; evaluate on held-out data
